# Extra Medium — full text for AI readers

Extra Medium (legal name Extra Medium LLC) is a founder-led strategy, creative, growth and technology studio and product lab headquartered in Virginia Beach, Virginia, USA, with presence in Chicago and London and clients across the US and UK. Tagline: "Whatever the medium. Make it matter." Positioning line: "Your business doesn't need more marketing. It needs something worth noticing."

## What Extra Medium does

The studio practices six chapters under one senior team:

1. Launch — positioning, naming, brand identity, website, go-to-market and product launch for things that do not exist yet or have not been introduced properly.
2. Reinvent — brand strategy, rebranding, messaging and website redesign for businesses that moved faster than their brand.
3. Grow — growth marketing with an owner: paid media, SEO and AI search, ecommerce and Shopify growth, lifecycle and creator channels, run as one system against revenue.
4. Lead — fractional CMO leadership for businesses that need a senior marketing brain without a permanent executive seat, plus executive and personal branding.
5. Intelligence — AI consulting, AI agents and automation wired into how a company actually operates, applied across marketing, reporting, creative development and workflow.
6. Experiences — podcasts, events and experiential marketing.

Engagement shapes: (1) fractional leadership, (2) a defined project with a clear beginning and end, scoped after the first conversation and priced with a clear range, (3) ongoing growth work. Process: a conversation, not a proposal; if the studio cannot help, it says so.

## Founder

Jeff Rimmer is Founder & Principal of Extra Medium, with more than 20 years in marketing across startups and Fortune 100 companies. Before Extra Medium he founded a digital music platform and grew it past 900,000 users. Deepest industry experience: music and entertainment, retail and ecommerce, healthcare and wellness. He leads every engagement personally. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/jeffrimmer

## Proof and range

Client work spans pre-launch startups, founder-led growth brands, makers and manufacturers, and Fortune 500 retail — including a growth system for a high-growth nutritional supplement brand, global marketing and post-acquisition brand integration for a radiation-protection manufacturer, ecommerce and app optimization for a Fortune 500 retailer's three banners, an enterprise licensing launch for a music company (early adopters included Microsoft and Baylor University), and the B2B positioning and website for a contract manufacturer's brand-creation division.

## Extra Medium Labs and SIGNL

Extra Medium Labs is the studio's product lab, where it builds and operates its own products. The flagship product is SIGNL (https://joinsignl.com), a local creator marketing platform:

- Problem: influencer marketing skipped local; neighborhood businesses need the local creators their customers actually follow.
- How it works: a business makes an offer (a comped visit or a paid booking); a local creator visits; the creator posts honestly (one post or reel plus two stories within 48 hours, disclosed); the business sees tracked results (register spend counted, media value modeled and labeled).
- Creators: free always; 500 followers is enough; tiers auto-assigned by stacked audience — Neighbors 500–2k, Locals 2k–15k, Headliners 15k+. On paid bookings creators keep 97% (business pays rate + 3%; $50 rate floor).
- Businesses: published plans at $299, $599 and $999 per month; applications decided within two business days; a Visit Guarantee replaces any no-show or unposted visit.
- Status (October 2026): live platform in founding-market formation across 37 founding markets in 8 countries; home market is Virginia Beach (covering Hampton Roads), activating first. Operated by Extra Medium LLC.

Other Labs ventures in development: Roon (memory-keeping app), JAWNRA (global music discovery and charts), hapsta (AI engine for spontaneous real-life plans).
